name: Animate Dead
description:
You touch one humanoid’s remains, and it rises as a zombie or skeleton under your control.

The remains must have at least three limbs and its head intact.

The undead creature acts on your turn. After 1 day, the creature collapses into grave dust.
paragraphs: You touch one humanoid’s remains, and it rises as a zombie or skeleton under your control.

The undead creature acts on your turn. After 1 day, the creature collapses into grave dust.

name: Command
description:
You issue a verbal command to one creature in range who can understand you. The command must be one word, such as “kneel.” The target obeys the command for as long as you focus.

If your command is ever directly harmful to the creature, it may make a Charisma check vs. your last spellcasting check. On a success, the spell ends.

name: Dispel Magic
description:
Choose a visible creature, item, magical feature, summon, or ongoing area spell within six squares. Pick the magical effect to end. Removing an effect from one creature leaves other creatures affected; removing an area such as Web or Silence ends that whole area.

Magic items, magical traps, and permanent magical locks are suppressed for ten rounds instead. Weapons and armor retain their ordinary properties. Suppressed potions become Potions of No Effect and are wasted if drunk. Suppressed wands cannot be used. Scrolls themselves cannot be dispelled, but their ongoing spell effects can. Mundane locks and traps are unaffected.

On an initial natural 20, choose two effects on one target, or one effect on each of two targets.

name: Fabricate
description:
This spell can't target creatures.

You turn a tree-sized collection of raw materials into a finished work. For example, you convert a pile of bricks or rocks into a bridge. The finished work converts back to raw materials when the spell ends.
paragraphs: This spell can't target creatures.

name: Fireball
description:
Choose an impact square within 12 squares and clear line of sight, then confirm the blast. Every creature in a centered 7-by-7 area, including allies and yourself, takes 4d6 fire damage. Walls and closed doors block the blast; separate underpass routes are unaffected.

Exposed treasure follows the normal fire-damage rules, and any Web touched by the flames burns.

On an initial natural 20, choose 8d6 damage or a 13-by-13 area.

damage.context: All creatures in a near-sized cube around where the flame lands take 4d6 damage.

name: Fly
description: Your feet lift from the ground, and you take to the air like a hummingbird. You can fly near for the spell's duration and are able to hover in place.
paragraphs: Your feet lift from the ground, and you take to the air like a hummingbird. You can fly near for the spell's duration and are able to hover in place.

name: Gaseous Form
description:
You and your gear turn into a cloud of smoke for the spell's duration.

You can fly and pass through any gap that smoke could. You can sense the terrain and any movement around you out to a near distance.

You can't cast spells while in this form.

name: Illusion
description:
Create a creature decoy, a three-by-three blank floor, or a three-by-three false pit within twelve squares. Maintain Focus to keep it present. A natural 20 allows two independently chosen and placed illusions under the same Focus.

Creature decoys join the party but never deal damage: every attack rolls a natural 1 without advantage or disadvantage. The horrible behemoth occupies three-by-three squares, has AC 20 and 60 HP, and immediately prompts nearby monster morale checks. Other creature forms use their normal stat blocks and one-square tokens.

Blank floor conceals dungeon features and automatically hides party members standing inside it. Leaving prompts a stealth check. Grounded monsters avoid a false pit, while flying creatures can cross it. Real hazards beneath blank floor still function.

A successful attack, monster contact, or a successful WIS inspection against the latest Focus total dismisses that entire illusion, leaving any other projection intact.

name: Lay To Rest
description:
You instantly send an undead creature you touch to its final afterlife, destroying it utterly.

You can target an undead creature of LV 9 or less.
paragraphs: You instantly send an undead creature you touch to its final afterlife, destroying it utterly.
You can target an undead creature of LV 9 or less.

name: Lightning Bolt
description:
Choose a direction and confirm the one-square-wide bolt. It extends a full 12 squares from you, even if you aim at a nearby square, unless a wall or closed door stops it. Every creature in its path, including allies, takes 3d6 lightning damage. Separate underpass routes are unaffected.

On an initial natural 20, choose 6d6 damage or a full 24-square bolt.
paragraphs: Choose a direction and confirm the one-square-wide bolt. It extends a full 12 squares from you, even if you aim at a nearby square, unless a wall or closed door stops it. Every creature in its path, including allies, takes 3d6 lightning damage. Separate underpass routes are unaffected.
On an initial natural 20, choose 6d6 damage or a full 24-square bolt.

damage.context: Creatures struck by the lightning take 3d6 damage.

name: Magic Circle
description:
You conjure a circle of runes out to near-sized cube centered on yourself and name a type of creature (for example, demons).

For the spell's duration, creatures of the chosen type cannot attack or cast a hostile spell on anyone inside the circle.

The chosen creatures also can’t possess, compel, or beguile anyone inside the circle.
paragraphs: You conjure a circle of runes out to near-sized cube centered on yourself and name a type of creature (for example, demons).
For the spell's duration, creatures of the chosen type cannot attack or cast a hostile spell on anyone inside the circle.
The chosen creatures also can’t possess, compel, or beguile anyone inside the circle.

name: Mass Cure
description: All allies within near range of you regain 2d6 hit points.
paragraphs: All allies within near range of you regain 2d6 hit points.

damage.context: All allies within near range of you regain 2d6 hit points.

name: Rebuke Unholy
description:
You rebuke creatures who oppose your alignment, forcing them to flee. You must present a holy symbol to cast this spell.

If you are lawful or neutral, this spell affects demons, devils, and outsiders. If you are chaotic, this spell affects angels and natural creatures of the wild.

Affected creatures within near of you must make a CHA check vs. your spellcasting check. If a creature fails by 10+ points and is equal to or less than your level, it is destroyed. Otherwise, on a fail, it flees from you for 5 rounds.

name: Restoration
description: With the touch of your hands, you expunge curses and illnesses. One curse, illness, or affliction of your choice affecting the target creature ends.
paragraphs: With the touch of your hands, you expunge curses and illnesses. One curse, illness, or affliction of your choice affecting the target creature ends.

name: Sending
description: You send a brief mental message to any creature with whom you are familiar who is on the same plane.
paragraphs: You send a brief mental message to any creature with whom you are familiar who is on the same plane.

name: Speak With Dead
description:
A dead body you touch answers your questions in a distant, wheezing voice.

You can ask the dead body up to three yes or no questions (one at a time). The GM truthfully answers "yes" or "no" to each.

If you cast this spell more than once in 24 hours, treat a failed spellcasting check for it as a critical failure instead.
